name: fishy
source:
You didn't want to go to the aquarium. You don't like aquariums. They freak you out.

But it's Monica's birthday, and everyone else is going, and besides - it's all in your head. Right?

A story about friends, enemies, acceptance, and the monsters waiting for us in the deep blue void. 

[From [url=https://i-choose-paradise.itch.io/fishy]Itch.io[/url]]
